This notebook merges two previously-separate steps into a single end-to-end
document:

           Reads raw per-sample count tables, runs alignment/replicate QC, and

## Helper and analysis functions

All function definitions are gathered here so the analysis chunks below stay
readable. The first group (QC / correlation helpers) comes from the re-analysis
notebook; the second group (library-level QC, expression statistics, allelic
effect models, Venn/comparison helpers) comes from the downstream notebook.
`extract_and_replace()` was defined identically in both notebooks and is kept
here only once.

```{r helper-functions, include=FALSE}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Group 1: QC, filtering, and correlation helpers (from the re-analysis step)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
flattenCorrMatrix <- function(cormat, pmat) {
  ut <- upper.tri(cormat)
  data.frame(
    row = rownames(cormat)[row(cormat)[ut]],
    column = rownames(cormat)[col(cormat)[ut]],
    cor  =(cormat)[ut],
    p = pmat[ut]
    )
}
#To get this to work with downstream stuff, I need to remove the "=*" portions
extract_and_replace <- function(x) {
  rs_numbers <- str_extract_all(x, "rs\\d+")
  if (length(rs_numbers) > 0) {
    str_replace_all(x, ".*?(rs\\d+).*", "\\1")
  } else {
    x
  }
}

apply_operation <- function(data, column_names) {
  for (col_name in column_names) {
    # Calculate the sum for the specified column
    col_sum <- sum(data[[col_name]])
    # Apply the operation to the column
    data[, paste0(col_name, ".cpm") := (data[[col_name]] / col_sum) * 1e6]
  }
  return(data)
}

# Function to create filtered tables based on unique barcode counts
create_filtered_table <- function(dt, min_unique_barcodes) {
  # Ensure input is a data.table
  if (!is.data.table(dt)) dt <- as.data.table(dt)
  # Count unique barcodes per rsID
  barcode_counts <- dt[, .(unique_barcodes = uniqueN(revcomp_barcode)), by = rsID]
  
  # Filter rsIDs that meet the threshold
  filtered_rsids <- barcode_counts[unique_barcodes >= min_unique_barcodes, rsID]
  
  # Filter original data by these rsIDs
  filtered_data <- dt[rsID %in% filtered_rsids]
  
  # Get columns 2:7 to average
  cols_to_avg <- names(dt)[2:25]
  
  # Average the values for each rsID
  result <- filtered_data[, lapply(.SD, mean), by = rsID, .SDcols = cols_to_avg]
  
  return(result)
}

# Split data.isompra into pre-spliced and post-spliced based on column names
split_isompra_data <- function(dt) {
  # Get all column names
  all_cols <- names(dt)
  
  # Identify ID columns
  id_cols <- c("rsID", "aav", "revcomp_barcode")
  id_cols <- id_cols[id_cols %in% all_cols]
  
  # Identify pre-spliced and post-spliced columns based on their names
  pre_splice_cols <- grep("pre", all_cols, ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)
  post_splice_cols <- grep("post", all_cols, ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)
  
  # Remove any id_cols that might have matched the pattern
  pre_splice_cols <- pre_splice_cols[!pre_splice_cols %in% id_cols]
  post_splice_cols <- post_splice_cols[!post_splice_cols %in% id_cols]
  
  # Create pre-spliced and post-spliced data tables
  pre_splice_dt <- dt[, c(id_cols, pre_splice_cols), with = FALSE]
  post_splice_dt <- dt[, c(id_cols, post_splice_cols), with = FALSE]
  
  # Print the columns for verification
  cat("Pre-spliced columns found:", length(pre_splice_cols), "\n")
  cat(paste(pre_splice_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n\n")
  
  cat("Post-spliced columns found:", length(post_splice_cols), "\n")
  cat(paste(post_splice_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  
  # Return both tables with column info
  return(list(
    pre_splice = pre_splice_dt, 
    post_splice = post_splice_dt,
    pre_cols = pre_splice_cols,
    post_cols = post_splice_cols
  ))
}

# Calculate expression values for a given data.table
calculate_expression <- function(dt, dna_column) {
  library(data.table)  # ensure data.table is loaded

  # Ensure input is a data.table
  if (!is.data.table(dt)) dt <- as.data.table(dt)

  # Get all column names
  all_cols <- names(dt)
  
  # Exclude standard columns to get RNA columns
  std_cols <- c("rsID", dna_column, "revcomp_barcode")
  std_cols <- std_cols[std_cols %in% all_cols]
  rna_cols <- all_cols[!all_cols %in% std_cols]
  
  # Create new data.table with rsID
  result <- copy(dt[, .SD, .SDcols = "rsID"])
  
  # For each RNA column, calculate log2(RNA/DNA)
  for (rna_col in rna_cols) {
    # Create expression column name
    new_col_name <- paste0("expr_", rna_col)
    
    # Calculate log2(RNA/DNA)
    result[, (new_col_name) := log2(dt[[rna_col]] / dt[[dna_column]])]
  }
  
  return(list(expr_dt = result, expr_cols = paste0("expr_", rna_cols)))
}

# Calculate average expression across replicates
calculate_average_expression <- function(expr_dt, expr_cols) {
  # Start with rsID column
  avg_dt <- data.table(rsID = expr_dt$rsID)
  
  # Get all columns except rsID
  all_cols <- setdiff(names(expr_dt), "rsID")
  
  # Print information for debugging
  cat("Number of expression columns found:", length(all_cols), "\n")
  
  if (length(all_cols) > 0) {
    # Use base R to calculate the mean for each row
    # This avoids data.table's .SDcols syntax entirely
    expression_data <- as.matrix(expr_dt[, ..all_cols])
    avg_dt$avg_expr <- rowMeans(expression_data, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    cat("Successfully calculated average expression values.\n")
  } else {
    warning("No expression columns found!")
    avg_dt$avg_expr <- NA_real_
  }
  
  return(avg_dt)
}

# Create correlation plots between data.empra and data.isompra average expressions
create_correlation_plots <- function(empra_avg_dt, isompra_avg_dt, threshold, splice_type) {
  # Merge the average expression tables by rsID
  merged_dt <- merge(empra_avg_dt, isompra_avg_dt, by = "rsID", suffixes = c("_empra", "_isompra"))
  
  # Calculate Pearson correlation
  pearson <- suppressWarnings(
    cor.test(merged_dt$avg_expr_empra, merged_dt$avg_expr_isompra, 
             method = "pearson", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
  )
  
  # Calculate Spearman correlation
  spearman <- suppressWarnings(
    cor.test(merged_dt$avg_expr_empra, merged_dt$avg_expr_isompra, 
             method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
  )
  
  # Create scatter plot
  plot_title <- paste0(splice_type, " vs Empra Average Expression (≥", threshold, " barcodes)")
  
  p <- ggplot(merged_dt, aes(x = avg_expr_empra, y = avg_expr_isompra)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "red", se = TRUE) +
    labs(
      title = plot_title,
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Pearson r = ", round(pearson$estimate, 3), 
        " (p = ", format.pval(pearson$p.value, digits = 3), ")\n",
        "Spearman ρ = ", round(spearman$estimate, 3),
        " (p = ", format.pval(spearman$p.value, digits = 3), ")\n",
        "n = ", nrow(merged_dt), " rsIDs"
      ),
      x = "data.empra Average Expression",
      y = paste0(splice_type, " Average Expression")
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
  
  # Create summary data.table with correlation results
  summary_dt <- data.table(
    threshold = threshold,
    splice_type = splice_type,
    n_rsids = nrow(merged_dt),
    pearson_cor = pearson$estimate,
    pearson_pval = pearson$p.value,
    spearman_cor = spearman$estimate,
    spearman_pval = spearman$p.value
  )
  
  return(list(
    plot = p,
    summary = summary_dt,
    merged_data = merged_dt
  ))
}

# Function to process one EMPRA dataset (standard or down) and compare to ISOMPRA
process_empra_vs_isompra <- function(empra_data, isompra_data, prefix = "standard") {
  # 1. Clean datasets
  empra_data <- empra_data[rowSums(is.na(empra_data[, 2:25])) == 0, ]
  isompra_data <- isompra_data[rowSums(is.na(isompra_data[, 2:38])) == 0, ]

  # 2. Filter by thresholds
  thresholds <- c(5, 10, 15, 20)
  empra_filtered <- lapply(thresholds, function(t) create_filtered_table(empra_data, t))
  names(empra_filtered) <- paste0("dt_", thresholds, "plus")

  # 3. Calculate expression for each EMPRA threshold
  empra_exprs <- lapply(empra_filtered, function(dt) calculate_expression(dt, "aav"))
  names(empra_exprs) <- paste0("expr_dt_", thresholds, "plus")

  # 4. Split ISOMPRA
  isompra_split <- split_isompra_data(isompra_data)
  pre_splice_dt <- isompra_split$pre_splice
  post_splice_dt <- isompra_split$post_splice
  pre_splice_expr <- calculate_expression(pre_splice_dt, "aav")
  post_splice_expr <- calculate_expression(post_splice_dt, "aav")
  pre_splice_avg <- calculate_average_expression(pre_splice_expr$expr_dt, pre_splice_expr$expr_cols)
  post_splice_avg <- calculate_average_expression(post_splice_expr$expr_dt, post_splice_expr$expr_cols)

  # 5. Run correlation analysis per threshold
  result_list <- list()

  for (i in seq_along(thresholds)) {
    threshold <- thresholds[i]
    empra_expr <- empra_exprs[[i]]

    if (is.list(empra_expr) && "expr_dt" %in% names(empra_expr)) {
      empra_expr_dt <- empra_expr$expr_dt
    } else {
      empra_expr_dt <- empra_expr
    }

    empra_expr_cols <- grep("^expr_", names(empra_expr_dt), value = TRUE)
    empra_avg <- data.table(rsID = empra_expr_dt$rsID)

    if (length(empra_expr_cols) > 0) {
      expr_values <- as.data.frame(empra_expr_dt)[, empra_expr_cols, drop = FALSE]
      empra_avg$avg_expr <- rowMeans(expr_values, na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      empra_avg$avg_expr <- NA_real_
    }

    pre_result <- create_correlation_plots(empra_avg, pre_splice_avg, threshold, paste0(prefix, "_Pre-Spliced"))
    post_result <- create_correlation_plots(empra_avg, post_splice_avg, threshold, paste0(prefix, "_Post-Spliced"))

    result_list[[length(result_list) + 1]] <- pre_result
    result_list[[length(result_list) + 1]] <- post_result
  }

  return(result_list)
}


# Function to calculate average correlations
calculate_avg_correlation <- function(cor_matrix) {
  # Get only upper triangle values (excluding diagonal)
  upper_tri <- cor_matrix[upper.tri(cor_matrix)]
  return(list(
    mean = mean(upper_tri),
    median = median(upper_tri),
    min = min(upper_tri),
    max = max(upper_tri)
  ))
}

calculate_avg_correlation_per_replicate <- function(cor_matrix) {
  # Ensure it's a square matrix
  if (!is.matrix(cor_matrix) || nrow(cor_matrix) != ncol(cor_matrix)) {
    stop("Input must be a square matrix.")
  }

  n <- nrow(cor_matrix)
  
  # Initialize vectors
  means <- numeric(n)
  medians <- numeric(n)
  mins <- numeric(n)
  maxs <- numeric(n)
  
  for (i in 1:n) {
    # Exclude self-correlation
    other_values <- cor_matrix[i, -i]
    
    means[i] <- mean(other_values, na.rm = TRUE)
    medians[i] <- median(other_values, na.rm = TRUE)
    mins[i] <- min(other_values, na.rm = TRUE)
    maxs[i] <- max(other_values, na.rm = TRUE)
  }
  
  # Create a data.frame for clarity
  return(data.frame(
    replicate = rownames(cor_matrix),
    mean = means,
    median = medians,
    min = mins,
    max = maxs
  ))
}


# Function to create correlation matrix and plot from structured data
create_correlogram <- function(expr_object, title, method = "pearson") {
  # Extract data table and column names if this is a structured object
  if (is.list(expr_object) && !is.data.frame(expr_object) && "expr_dt" %in% names(expr_object)) {
    cat("Input is a structured object with expr_dt and expr_cols\n")
    expr_dt <- expr_object$expr_dt
    expr_cols <- expr_object$expr_cols
  } else {
    cat("Input appears to be a data frame/data table\n")
    expr_dt <- expr_object
    expr_cols <- grep("^expr_", names(expr_dt), value = TRUE)
  }
  
  # Print information
  cat("Data dimensions:", nrow(expr_dt), "rows x", ncol(expr_dt), "columns\n")
  cat("Expression columns to use:", paste(expr_cols, collapse=", "), "\n")
  
  # Verify columns exist in data
  missing_cols <- setdiff(expr_cols, names(expr_dt))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    cat("Warning: These columns don't exist in the data:", paste(missing_cols, collapse=", "), "\n")
    expr_cols <- intersect(expr_cols, names(expr_dt))
    cat("Using only these columns:", paste(expr_cols, collapse=", "), "\n")
  }
  
  # Check if we have enough columns
  if (length(expr_cols) < 2) {
    stop("Need at least 2 expression columns to calculate correlations")
  }
  
  # Extract expression data
  expr_data <- as.data.frame(expr_dt)[, expr_cols, drop = FALSE]
  
  # Calculate correlation matrix
  cor_matrix <- cor(expr_data, method = method, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
  
  # Clean labels
  clean_labels <- gsub("^expr_", "", colnames(cor_matrix))
  colnames(cor_matrix) <- clean_labels
  rownames(cor_matrix) <- clean_labels
  
  # Plot correlation matrix
  corrplot(cor_matrix, 
           method = "color", 
           type = "upper",
           addCoef.col = "black",
           tl.col = "black",
           tl.srt = 45,
           diag = FALSE,
           title = paste0(title, " (", toupper(substr(method, 1, 1)), substr(method, 2, nchar(method)), ")"),
           mar = c(0, 0, 2, 0))
  
  return(cor_matrix)
}

# Function to calculate and plot correlations at barcode level
analyze_barcode_level_correlations <- function(data, dna_column, title = "Barcode-Level Correlations") {
  # Get replicate columns (excluding ID columns and DNA column)
  replicate_cols <- setdiff(names(data), c("rsID", "revcomp_barcode", dna_column))
  
  # Calculate log2(RNA/DNA) for each replicate at barcode level
  expr_dt <- copy(data)
  for (col in replicate_cols) {
    new_col <- paste0("expr_", col)
    expr_dt[, (new_col) := log2(get(col) / get(dna_column))]
  }
  
  # Get expression column names
  expr_cols <- paste0("expr_", replicate_cols)
  
  # Calculate correlation matrix for barcode-level expressions
  expr_data <- as.data.frame(expr_dt)[, expr_cols, drop = FALSE]
  barcode_cor_matrix <- cor(expr_data, method = "pearson", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
  
  # Calculate correlation matrix using Spearman
  barcode_cor_matrix_spearman <- cor(expr_data, method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
  
  # Clean labels
  clean_labels <- gsub("^expr_", "", colnames(barcode_cor_matrix))
  colnames(barcode_cor_matrix) <- clean_labels
  rownames(barcode_cor_matrix) <- clean_labels
  colnames(barcode_cor_matrix_spearman) <- clean_labels
  rownames(barcode_cor_matrix_spearman) <- clean_labels
  
  # Create plots for barcode-level correlations
  pdf("correlogram_plots/barcode_level_correlogram.pdf", width = 10, height = 10)
  par(mfrow = c(2, 1))
  
  # Pearson
  corrplot(barcode_cor_matrix, 
           method = "color", 
           type = "upper",
           addCoef.col = "black",
           tl.col = "black",
           tl.srt = 45,
           diag = FALSE,
           title = paste0(title, " (Pearson)"),
           mar = c(0, 0, 2, 0))
  
  # Spearman
  corrplot(barcode_cor_matrix_spearman, 
           method = "color", 
           type = "upper",
           addCoef.col = "black",
           tl.col = "black",
           tl.srt = 45,
           diag = FALSE,
           title = paste0(title, " (Spearman)"),
           mar = c(0, 0, 2, 0))
  
  dev.off()
  
  # Return correlation matrices
  return(list(
    pearson = barcode_cor_matrix,
    spearman = barcode_cor_matrix_spearman
  ))
}

# Function to compare barcode-level vs element-level correlations
compare_barcode_vs_element_correlations <- function(barcode_cors, element_cors) {
  # Extract upper triangle values from correlation matrices, excluding diagonal
  extract_upper_tri <- function(cor_matrix) {
    cor_matrix[upper.tri(cor_matrix)]
  }
  
  # Get correlation values
  barcode_pearson_vals <- extract_upper_tri(barcode_cors$pearson)
  barcode_spearman_vals <- extract_upper_tri(barcode_cors$spearman)
  element_pearson_vals <- extract_upper_tri(element_cors$pearson)
  element_spearman_vals <- extract_upper_tri(element_cors$spearman)
  
  # Create data frame for plotting
  comparison_df <- data.frame(
    Level = c(rep("Barcode", length(barcode_pearson_vals) + length(barcode_spearman_vals)),
              rep("Element", length(element_pearson_vals) + length(element_spearman_vals))),
    Method = c(rep("Pearson", length(barcode_pearson_vals)),
               rep("Spearman", length(barcode_spearman_vals)),
               rep("Pearson", length(element_pearson_vals)),
               rep("Spearman", length(element_spearman_vals))),
    Correlation = c(barcode_pearson_vals, barcode_spearman_vals,
                   element_pearson_vals, element_spearman_vals)
  )
  
  # Create comparison boxplot
  comparison_plot <- ggplot(comparison_df, aes(x = interaction(Level, Method), y = Correlation, fill = Level)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    labs(
      title = "Comparison of Correlations: Barcode-Level vs Element-Level",
      x = "",
      y = "Correlation Coefficient",
      fill = "Analysis Level"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    )
  
  # Save the plot
  ggsave("correlogram_plots/barcode_vs_element_comparison.png", comparison_plot, width = 10, height = 6)
  
  # Calculate summary statistics
  summary_stats <- data.frame(
    Level = c("Barcode", "Barcode", "Element", "Element"),
    Method = c("Pearson", "Spearman", "Pearson", "Spearman"),
    Mean = c(mean(barcode_pearson_vals), mean(barcode_spearman_vals),
             mean(element_pearson_vals), mean(element_spearman_vals)),
    Median = c(median(barcode_pearson_vals), median(barcode_spearman_vals),
               median(element_pearson_vals), median(element_spearman_vals)),
    Min = c(min(barcode_pearson_vals), min(barcode_spearman_vals),
            min(element_pearson_vals), min(element_spearman_vals)),
    Max = c(max(barcode_pearson_vals), max(barcode_spearman_vals),
            max(element_pearson_vals), max(element_spearman_vals))
  )
  
  return(list(
    plot = comparison_plot,
    summary = summary_stats
  ))
}

create_correlogram_cpm <- function(expr_object, title, method = "pearson") {
  # Extract data table and column names if this is a structured object
  if (is.list(expr_object) && !is.data.frame(expr_object)) {
    if ("expr_dt" %in% names(expr_object) && "expr_cols" %in% names(expr_object)) {
      cat("Input is a structured object with expr_dt and expr_cols\n")
      expr_dt <- expr_object$expr_dt
      expr_cols <- expr_object$expr_cols
    } else if ("cpm_dt" %in% names(expr_object) && "cpm_cols" %in% names(expr_object)) {
      cat("Input is a structured object with cpm_dt and cpm_cols\n")
      expr_dt <- expr_object$cpm_dt
      expr_cols <- expr_object$cpm_cols
    } else {
      stop("List object missing required components: expr_dt/expr_cols or cpm_dt/cpm_cols")
    }
  } else {
    cat("Input appears to be a data frame/data table\n")
    expr_dt <- expr_object
    expr_cols <- grep("^expr_", names(expr_dt), value = TRUE)
  }
  
  # Print information
  cat("Data dimensions:", nrow(expr_dt), "rows x", ncol(expr_dt), "columns\n")
  cat("Expression columns to use:", paste(expr_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  
  # Verify columns exist in data
  missing_cols <- setdiff(expr_cols, names(expr_dt))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    cat("Warning: These columns don't exist in the data:", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")
    expr_cols <- intersect(expr_cols, names(expr_dt))
    cat("Using only these columns:", paste(expr_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  }
  
  # Check if we have enough columns
  if (length(expr_cols) < 2) {
    stop("Need at least 2 expression columns to calculate correlations")
  }
  
  # Extract expression data
  expr_data <- as.data.frame(expr_dt)[, expr_cols, drop = FALSE]
  
  # Ensure all columns are numeric
  expr_data[] <- lapply(expr_data, as.numeric)
  
  # Calculate correlation matrix
  cor_matrix <- cor(expr_data, method = method, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
  
  # Clean labels
  clean_labels <- gsub("^expr_|^cpm_", "", colnames(cor_matrix))
  colnames(cor_matrix) <- clean_labels
  rownames(cor_matrix) <- clean_labels
  
  # Plot correlation matrix
  corrplot::corrplot(cor_matrix, 
           method = "color", 
           type = "upper",
           addCoef.col = "black",
           tl.col = "black",
           tl.srt = 45,
           diag = FALSE,
           title = paste0(title, " (", toupper(substr(method, 1, 1)), substr(method, 2, nchar(method)), ")"),
           mar = c(0, 0, 2, 0))
  
  return(cor_matrix)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Group 2: downstream analysis helpers (library QC, expression stats,
#          allelic-effect models, comparison/Venn plotting, etc.)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
#The following code takes the same data table above and extracts all expression
#values bearing shuf for allele, to use as the null dataset, and tests each
#set of ref values for each RSID, in a similar manner to the LMM before, using
#BC as a random effect and all the shufs as the null dataset - this is
#preferable to doing t-tests and averaging on BC as we think BC's might be doing
#something, hence the mixed model for nearly everything we test
perform_lmm <- function(dt) {
  # Filter for values with allele tag "shuf" and store as shuf_as_null
  shuf_as_null <- dt[Allele == "shuf", .(Expression, BC)]

  # Filter for values with allele tag "ref" and store as test_set
  test_set <- dt[Allele == "ref", .(Expression, Element, BC)]

  # Create an empty data.table to store the results
  results <- data.table(Element = character(), p_value = numeric(), diff_mean = numeric())

  # Iterate over unique values in test_set$Element
  unique_elements <- unique(test_set$Element)
  for (element in unique_elements) {
    # Filter test_set for current Element
    filtered_set <- test_set[Element == element, .(Expression, BC)]

    # Perform linear mixed model using shuf_as_null as null dataset
    lmm <- lmer(Expression ~ 1 + (1 | BC), data = rbind(filtered_set, shuf_as_null))

    # Extract p-value and difference of means from the model summary
    fixed_effects <- fixef(lmm)
    p_value <- summary(lmm)$coefficients["(Intercept)", "Pr(>|t|)"]
    diff_mean <- fixed_effects["(Intercept)"]

    # Store the results in the results data.table
    results <- rbind(results, data.table(Element = element, p_value = p_value, diff_mean = diff_mean))
  }

  # Return the results data.table
  return(results)
}

# Sanity check: t-tests to confirm the mixed-model results are consistent
perform_t_tests <- function(dt) {
  # Filter for values with allele tag "shuf" and store as shuf_as_null
  shuf_as_null <- dt[Allele == "shuf", .(Expression, Element)]

  # Filter for values with allele tag "ref" and store as test_set
  test_set <- dt[Allele == "ref", .(Expression, Element)]

  # Create an empty data.table to store the results
  result_table <- data.table(Element = character(), Difference_of_Means = numeric(), P_Value = numeric())

  # Iterate over unique values in test_set$Element
  unique_elements <- unique(test_set$Element)
  for (element in unique_elements) {
    # Filter test_set for current Element
    filtered_set <- test_set[Element == element, Expression]

    # Perform t-test comparing the current Element to shuffled expression values
    t_test <- t.test(filtered_set, shuf_as_null$Expression)

    # Extract p-value from the t-test result
    p_value <- t_test$p.value

    # Calculate the difference of means
    diff_mean <- mean(filtered_set) - mean(shuf_as_null$Expression)

    # Append the results to the result_table
    result_table <- rbind(result_table, data.table(Element = element, Difference_of_Means = diff_mean, P_Value = p_value))
  }

  # Return the result_table
  return(result_table)
}

countOccurrences <- function(data, column, pattern) {
  # Convert the column to character if not already
  if (!is.character(data[[column]])) {
    data[[column]] <- as.character(data[[column]])
  }
  
  # Count the occurrences of the pattern using grepl
  count <- sum(grepl(pattern, data[[column]], ignore.case = TRUE), na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Return the count
  return(count)
}

performChiSquareTest <- function(data,data2,ID1,ID2) {
  # Subset the data for "cases" and "controls"
  
  cases<-countOccurrences(data,"ID",ID1)
  controls<-countOccurrences(data,"ID",ID2)
  cases.sig<-countOccurrences(data2,"ID",ID1)
  controls.sig<-countOccurrences(data2,"ID",ID2)
  
  # Create a contingency table
  contingency_table <- matrix(c(cases, controls), nrow = 2, dimnames = list(c("cases", "controls")))
  contingency_table2<-matrix(c(cases.sig, controls.sig), nrow = 2, dimnames = list(c("cases", "controls")))
  contingency_table<-bind_cols(contingency_table2,contingency_table)
  names(contingency_table)<-c("Sig","Non-Sig")
  contingency_table$'Non-Sig'<-contingency_table$'Non-Sig'-contingency_table$'Sig'
  print(contingency_table)
  
  # Perform Fisher's exact test
  fisher_test_result <- fisher.test(contingency_table)
  
  # Return the test result
  return(fisher_test_result)
}

analyze_mpra_library <- function(data_file) {
  # Convert data.table to data.frame
  df <- as.data.frame(data_file)
  
  # Check if required columns exist
  required_cols <- c("Allele", "Expression", "BiolRep", "Element")
  if (!all(required_cols %in% colnames(df))) {
    stop(paste("Missing required columns:", 
               paste(setdiff(required_cols, colnames(df)), collapse = ", ")))
  }
  
  # Convert factors to character
  df$Allele <- as.character(df$Allele)
  df$BiolRep <- as.character(df$BiolRep)
  df$Element <- as.character(df$Element)
  
  # Separate scrambled and non-scrambled elements
  scrambled <- df %>% filter(Allele == "shuf")
  non_scrambled <- df %>% filter(Allele == "ref")
  
  # Calculate mean and standard deviation of scrambled elements
  scrambled_stats <- scrambled %>%
    group_by(BiolRep)%>%
    dplyr::summarise(mean = mean(Expression, na.rm = TRUE), 
              sd = sd(Expression, na.rm = TRUE), 
              .groups = "drop")
  
  # Calculate overall mean and sd for scrambled elements
  overall_mean <- mean(scrambled$Expression, na.rm = TRUE)
  overall_sd <- sd(scrambled$Expression, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Function to calculate z-score for each replicate
  calculate_zscore <- function(expression, rep, stats_df, overall_mean, overall_sd) {
    rep_stats <- stats_df %>% filter(BiolRep == rep)
    if (nrow(rep_stats) == 0 || is.na(rep_stats$sd) || rep_stats$sd == 0) {
      return((expression - overall_mean) / overall_sd)
    } else {
      return((expression - rep_stats$mean) / rep_stats$sd)
    }
  }
  
  # Calculate z-scores for non-scrambled elements
  non_scrambled <- non_scrambled %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(zscore = calculate_zscore(Expression, BiolRep, scrambled_stats, overall_mean, overall_sd)) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  # Perform linear mixed-effects model for each non-scrambled element
  lmer_results <- non_scrambled %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Element) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      model = list(tryCatch(
        lmer(zscore ~ 1 + (1|BiolRep)),
        error = function(e) lm(zscore ~ 1)  # Fallback to simple linear model if lmer fails
      )),
      coef = ifelse(inherits(model[[1]], "lmerMod"),
                    coef(summary(model[[1]]))[1, "Estimate"],
                    coef(summary(model[[1]]))[1, "Estimate"]),
      se = ifelse(inherits(model[[1]], "lmerMod"),
                  coef(summary(model[[1]]))[1, "Std. Error"],
                  coef(summary(model[[1]]))[1, "Std. Error"]),
      t_value = ifelse(inherits(model[[1]], "lmerMod"),
                       coef(summary(model[[1]]))[1, "t value"],
                       coef(summary(model[[1]]))[1, "t value"]),
      p_value = ifelse(inherits(model[[1]], "lmerMod"),
                       2 * (1 - pt(abs(t_value), df = df.residual(model[[1]]))),
                       summary(model[[1]])$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|t|)"]),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # Correct for multiple testing
  lmer_results <- lmer_results %>%
    mutate(fdr=p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"))
  
  # Classify elements as enhancers or repressors
  results <- lmer_results %>%
    mutate(classification = case_when(
      fdr < 0.05 & coef > 0 ~ 'enhancer',
      fdr < 0.05 & coef < 0 ~ 'repressor',
      TRUE ~ 'neutral'
    ))
  
  return(results)
}


analyze_mpra_library.empra <- function(data_file) {
  # Load required libraries
  library(lme4)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)

  # Convert data.table to data.frame
  df <- as.data.frame(data_file)
  
  # Check if required columns exist
  required_cols <- c("Allele", "Expression", "BiolRep", "Element", "BC")
  if (!all(required_cols %in% colnames(df))) {
    stop(paste("Missing required columns:", paste(setdiff(required_cols, colnames(df)), collapse = ", ")))
  }
  
  # Convert factors to character
  df$Allele <- as.character(df$Allele)
  df$BiolRep <- as.character(df$BiolRep)
  df$Element <- as.character(df$Element)
  df$BC <- as.character(df$BC)
  
  # Separate scrambled and non-scrambled elements
  scrambled <- df %>% filter(Allele == "shuf")
  non_scrambled <- df %>% filter(Allele == "ref")
  
  # Calculate mean and standard deviation of scrambled elements
  scrambled_stats <- scrambled %>%
    group_by(BiolRep) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      mean = mean(Expression, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd = sd(Expression, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # Calculate overall mean and sd for scrambled elements
  overall_mean <- mean(scrambled$Expression, na.rm = TRUE)
  overall_sd <- sd(scrambled$Expression, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Function to calculate z-score for each replicate
  calculate_zscore <- function(expression, rep, stats_df, overall_mean, overall_sd) {
    rep_stats <- stats_df %>% filter(BiolRep == rep)
    if (nrow(rep_stats) == 0 || is.na(rep_stats$sd) || rep_stats$sd == 0) {
      return((expression - overall_mean) / overall_sd)
    } else {
      return((expression - rep_stats$mean) / rep_stats$sd)
    }
  }
  
  # Calculate z-scores for non-scrambled elements
  non_scrambled <- non_scrambled %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(zscore = calculate_zscore(Expression, BiolRep, scrambled_stats, overall_mean, overall_sd)) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  # Function to fit models with increasing simplicity
  fit_model <- function(data) {
    tryCatch({
      if (n_distinct(data$BC) > 1 && n_distinct(data$BiolRep) > 1) {
        model <- lmer(zscore ~ 1 + (1|BiolRep) + (1|BC), data = data, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))
        if (isSingular(model)) {
          model <- lmer(zscore ~ 1 + (1|BiolRep), data = data, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))
          if (isSingular(model)) {
            model <- lm(zscore ~ 1, data = data)
          }
        }
      } else if (n_distinct(data$BC) > 1) {
        model <- lm(zscore ~ BC, data = data)
      } else {
        model <- lm(zscore ~ 1, data = data)
      }
      return(model)
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning(paste("Error in model for Element", data$Element[1], ":", e$message))
      return(lm(zscore ~ 1, data = data))
    })
  }
  
  # Perform model fitting for each non-scrambled element
  lmer_results <- non_scrambled %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Element) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      model = list(fit_model(cur_data())),
      coef = ifelse(inherits(model[[1]], "lmerMod"),
                    fixef(model[[1]])[1],
                    coef(model[[1]])[1]),
      se = ifelse(inherits(model[[1]], "lmerMod"),
                  sqrt(diag(vcov(model[[1]])))[1],
                  summary(model[[1]])$coefficients[1, "Std. Error"]),
      t_value = coef / se,
      p_value = 2 * (1 - pt(abs(t_value), df = ifelse(inherits(model[[1]], "lmerMod"),
                                                      df.residual(model[[1]]),
                                                      df.residual(model[[1]])))),
      model_type = ifelse(inherits(model[[1]], "lmerMod"),
                          "mixed",
                          "fixed"),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # Correct for multiple testing
  lmer_results <- lmer_results %>%
    mutate(fdr = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"))
  
  # Classify elements as enhancers or repressors
  results <- lmer_results %>%
    mutate(classification = case_when(
      fdr < 0.05 & coef > 0 ~ 'enhancer',
      fdr < 0.05 & coef < 0 ~ 'repressor',
      TRUE ~ 'neutral'
    ))
  
  return(results)
}
```
