## Identifying Differences in Expression by MPRA Type - Probably Incorrect

```{r MPRA Type Analysis eMPRA, include = T}


# Load necessary libraries in the correct order
# If plyr is loaded, make sure to load it BEFORE dplyr
# Or better, detach plyr if you don't need it
if("package:plyr" %in% search()) detach("package:plyr", unload=TRUE)

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr) # For adding p-values to plots

# Assuming your data frame is called data.empra
# First, let's create a new grouping variable to simplify our comparison
data.empra$group <- ifelse(data.empra$Allele == "shuf", "shuffled", "reference")

# Get summary statistics for each group
summary_stats <- data.empra %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(
    count = n(),
    mean_expression = mean(Expression, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_expression = median(Expression, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_expression = sd(Expression, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Load necessary libraries
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(car) # For Levene's test
library(nortest) # For Anderson-Darling test

# Extract data for each group
shuf_expr <- data.empra$Expression[data.empra$group == "shuffled"]
ref_expr <- data.empra$Expression[data.empra$group == "reference"]

# 1. Check sample sizes
n_shuf <- length(shuf_expr)
n_ref <- length(ref_expr)
print(paste("Shuffled group size:", n_shuf))
print(paste("Reference group size:", n_ref))

# 2. Test for normality
# Shapiro-Wilk test (for smaller samples, n < 5000)
shapiro_shuf <- shapiro.test(shuf_expr)
#shapiro_ref <- shapiro.test(ref_expr)
#print("Normality tests (Shapiro-Wilk):")
#print(paste("Shuffled group p-value:", shapiro_shuf$p.value))
#print(paste("Reference group p-value:", shapiro_ref$p.value))

# Anderson-Darling test (better for larger samples)
ad_shuf <- ad.test(shuf_expr)
ad_ref <- ad.test(ref_expr)
print("Normality tests (Anderson-Darling):")
print(paste("Shuffled group p-value:", ad_shuf$p.value))
print(paste("Reference group p-value:", ad_ref$p.value))

# 3. Test for equal variances
levene_result <- leveneTest(Expression ~ group, data = data.empra)
print("Levene's test for homogeneity of variance:")
print(levene_result)

# 4. QQ plots for visual assessment of normality
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
qqnorm(shuf_expr, main = "QQ Plot - Shuffled Group")
qqline(shuf_expr)
qqnorm(ref_expr, main = "QQ Plot - Reference Group")
qqline(ref_expr)

# 5. Run multiple tests based on findings:

# a. Standard t-test (assuming equal variances)
t_test_equal_var <- t.test(shuf_expr, ref_expr, var.equal = TRUE)
print("Standard t-test (equal variances):")
print(t_test_equal_var)

# b. Welch's t-test (for unequal variances)
t_test_welch <- t.test(shuf_expr, ref_expr, var.equal = FALSE)
print("Welch's t-test (unequal variances):")
print(t_test_welch)

# c. Mann-Whitney U test (non-parametric alternative)
wilcox_result <- wilcox.test(shuf_expr, ref_expr)
print("Mann-Whitney U test (non-parametric):")
print(wilcox_result)

# Create plots with appropriate test results
# Determine which test to use based on test results
# This is a simplification; you may want to make a more informed choice
if (shapiro_shuf$p.value > 0.05 && shapiro_ref$p.value > 0.05) {
  if (levene_result$`Pr(>F)`[1] > 0.05) {
    test_to_use <- "t.test"
    p_value <- t_test_equal_var$p.value
    test_name <- "t-test"
  } else {
    test_to_use <- "t.test"
    p_value <- t_test_welch$p.value
    test_name <- "Welch's t-test"
  }
} else {
  test_to_use <- "wilcox.test"
  p_value <- wilcox_result$p.value
  test_name <- "Mann-Whitney U test"
}

# Create boxplot with chosen test
boxplot <- ggplot(data.empra, aes(x = group, y = Expression, fill = group)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  labs(
    title = "Expression Comparison by Allele Group",
    subtitle = paste(test_name, "p =", format(p_value, digits = 3)),
    x = "Group",
    y = "Expression Value"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Create violin plot with chosen test
violin_plot <- ggplot(data.empra, aes(x = group, y = Expression, fill = group)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, fill = "white", alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  labs(
    title = "Expression Distribution by Allele Group",
    subtitle = paste(test_name, "p =", format(p_value, digits = 3)),
    x = "Group",
    y = "Expression Value"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Display and save plots
print(boxplot)
print(violin_plot)
ggsave("expression_boxplot_empra.png", boxplot, width = 8, height = 6)
ggsave("expression_violin_plot_empra.png", violin_plot, width = 8, height = 6)
```

```{r Trying to do all together, include=T}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)  # For stat_compare_means

# Combine data (same as before)
empra_ref <- data.empra[group == "reference", .(Expression, group = "eMPRA_reference")]
post_ref <- postsplice[group == "reference", .(Expression, group = "Postsplice_reference")]
pre_ref <- presplice[group == "reference", .(Expression, group = "Presplice_reference")]
isompra_ref <- data.isompra[group == "reference", .(Expression, group = "ISOMPRA_reference")]
empra_shuf <- data.empra[group == "shuffled", .(Expression, group = "eMPRA_shuffled")]
post_shuf <- postsplice[group == "shuffled", .(Expression, group = "ISOMPRA_shuffled")]
pre_shuf <- presplice[group == "shuffled", .(Expression, group = "ISOMPRA_shuffled")]
isompra_shuf <- data.isompra[group == "shuffled", .(Expression, group = "ISOMPRA_shuffled")]

# Combine all
plotdata <- rbind(empra_ref, post_ref, pre_ref, isompra_ref,
                  empra_shuf, post_shuf, pre_shuf, isompra_shuf)

# Optional: make group a factor for ordered plotting
plotdata$group <- factor(plotdata$group, levels = c(
  "eMPRA_shuffled", "eMPRA_reference", "ISOMPRA_shuffled", "Postsplice_reference", "Presplice_reference", "ISOMPRA_reference"
))

# Perform the Wilcoxon tests and store results
wilcox_results <- list(
  "shuffled vs eMPRA_reference" = wilcox.test(
    plotdata$Expression[plotdata$group == "eMPRA_shuffled"],
    plotdata$Expression[plotdata$group == "eMPRA_reference"]
  ),
  
  "shuffled vs Postsplice_reference" = wilcox.test(
    plotdata$Expression[plotdata$group == "ISOMPRA_shuffled"],
    plotdata$Expression[plotdata$group == "Postsplice_reference"]
  ),
  
  "shuffled vs Presplice_reference" = wilcox.test(
    plotdata$Expression[plotdata$group == "ISOMPRA_shuffled"],
    plotdata$Expression[plotdata$group == "Presplice_reference"]
  ),
  
  "shuffled vs ISOMPRA_reference" = wilcox.test(
    plotdata$Expression[plotdata$group == "ISOMPRA_shuffled"],
    plotdata$Expression[plotdata$group == "ISOMPRA_reference"]
  )
)

# Print the results of each test
for (name in names(wilcox_results)) {
  cat("\n=== ", name, " ===\n")
  print(wilcox_results[[name]])
}

# Calculate medians for each group for summary table
group_medians <- aggregate(Expression ~ group, data = plotdata, FUN = median)

# Create a summary table with p-values
summary_table <- data.frame(
  Comparison = names(wilcox_results),
  P_value = sapply(wilcox_results, function(x) x$p.value),
  Significance = sapply(wilcox_results, function(x) {
    if (x$p.value < 0.001) return("***")
    else if (x$p.value < 0.01) return("**")
    else if (x$p.value < 0.05) return("*")
    else return("ns")
  })
)

# Print the summary table
print(summary_table)

# Create the plot as before
p <- ggplot(plotdata, aes(x = group, y = Expression, fill = group)) +
  geom_violin(width = 1.1, trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, outlier.size = 0.5, outlier.alpha = 0.5) +
  stat_compare_means(
    method = "wilcox.test", 
    comparisons = list(
      c("eMPRA_shuffled", "eMPRA_reference"),
      c("ISOMPRA_shuffled", "Postsplice_reference"),
      c("ISOMPRA_shuffled", "Presplice_reference"),
      c("ISOMPRA_shuffled", "ISOMPRA_reference")
    ),
    label = "p.signif",
    hide.ns = TRUE
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1)  # Add black border
  ) +
  labs(title = "Expression Comparison with Significance", x = "", y = "Expression")

# Display the plot
print(p)
```

## Enhancer and Repressor LM's

```{r Pre-Splice Enhance.Repress, include = T}
library(plyr)
allbcs.u <- read_csv("allbcs.u.csv")
allbcs.u<-dplyr::rename(allbcs.u,Element=rsID)

######################################################
#Method 3 on PreSplice (Tony's Way)
presplice.tmp<-filter(presplice,Allele=="ref")
presplice.tmp2<-filter(presplice,Allele=="shuf")
presplice.tmp<-bind_rows(presplice.tmp,presplice.tmp2)
enh_or_rep.presplice3 <- ddply(presplice.tmp,.(Element,Allele),shufttest,filter(presplice.tmp,Allele=="shuf")$Expression,"Expression")
enh_or_rep.presplice3$fdr <- p.adjust(enh_or_rep.presplice3$Pvalue,"BH")
enh_or_rep.presplice3$bonferroni <- p.adjust(enh_or_rep.presplice3$Pvalue,"bonferroni")

enh_or_rep.presplice3<-as.data.table(enh_or_rep.presplice3)
enh_or_rep.presplice3<-left_join(enh_or_rep.presplice3,allbcs.u,by="Element")
presplice_shuf <- enh_or_rep.presplice3 %>% .[,plotcolor := as.factor(case_when(
    (coef>log2(1.25) & fdr<0.1) ~ 1,
    (coef<log2(0.75) & fdr<0.1) ~ 2,
    TRUE ~ 3))]

ggplot(presplice_shuf)+
  geom_point(aes(x=coef,y=-log10(fdr),fill=plotcolor),shape=21,size=3)+
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("#e1be6a","#e1be6a","lightgrey"),
                    labels=c("Increased Expression","Decreased Expression",
                             "Not Significant"))+
  geom_text_repel(data=filter(presplice_shuf,plotcolor==1 | plotcolor==2),
                  aes(x=coef,y=-log10(fdr),label=""))+
  labs(fill="Expression Change",
       title="Reference vs. Shuffled Expression Change\nin Pre-Splicing Pool",
       x="Log2 Fold Change in Expression",
       y="-log10(FDR)")+
  geom_vline(xintercept = log2(0.75),linetype="dashed")+
  geom_vline(xintercept = log2(1.25),linetype="dashed")+
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.1),linetype="dashed")

#####################################################
#Method with making the shuffled across all elements

# First, extract just the rows with "shuf" Allele from presplice.tmp2
shuf_rows <- presplice.tmp2[Allele == "shuf"]

# Get the unique Elements from presplice.tmp
target_elements <- unique(presplice.tmp$Element)

# Create a new data.table to store all the combined results
combined_results <- copy(presplice.tmp)

# For each unique Element in presplice.tmp, take all 132 "shuf" rows 
# from presplice.tmp2 and add them with the Element column updated
for (elem in target_elements) {
  # Make a copy of all the shuf rows
  new_rows <- copy(shuf_rows)
  
  # Replace the Element in each row with the current Element from target_elements
  new_rows[, Element := elem]
  
  # Remove any existing "shuf" rows for this Element in combined_results
  combined_results <- combined_results[!(Element == elem & Allele == "shuf")]
  
  # Add the updated shuffled rows for this Element
  combined_results <- rbindlist(list(combined_results, new_rows), use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
}

# In case we need to ensure only unique rows in the final result
combined_results <- unique(combined_results)

shuf_presplice<-mpratools.lm(d=combined_results,
                         model = Expression ~ Allele,
                         ref.level = "shuf",
                         alt.level = "ref")

shuf_presplice <- shuf_presplice %>%
  .[,plotcolor := as.factor(case_when(
    (logFC>log2(1.25) & fdr<0.1) ~ 1,
    (logFC<log2(0.75) & fdr<0.1) ~ 2,
    TRUE ~ 3))]

shuf_presplice<-left_join(shuf_presplice,allbcs.u,by="Element")

ggplot(shuf_presplice)+
  geom_point(aes(x=logFC,y=-log10(fdr),fill=plotcolor),shape=21,size=3)+
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("#e1be6a","#e1be6a","lightgrey"),
                    labels=c("Increased Expression","Decreased Expression",
                             "Not Significant"))+
  geom_text_repel(data=filter(shuf_presplice,plotcolor==1 | plotcolor==2),
                  aes(x=logFC,y=-log10(fdr),label=Element))+
  labs(fill="Expression Change",
       title="Reference vs. Shuffled Expression Change\nin Pre-Splicing Pool",
       x="Log2 Fold Change in Expression",
       y="-log10(FDR)")+
  geom_vline(xintercept = log2(0.75),linetype="dashed")+
  geom_vline(xintercept = log2(1.25),linetype="dashed")+
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.1),linetype="dashed")

```

```{r eMPRA Enh.Rep, include =T}
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.1), linetype="dashed")

######################################################
  #Method 3.1  on eMPRA  after averaging Barcodes (Tony's Way)

empra.tmp<-filter(data.empra,Allele=="ref")
empra.tmp2<-filter(data.empra,Allele=="shuf")
empra.tmp<-bind_rows(empra.tmp,empra.tmp2)
empra.tmp<-empra.tmp[, .(Expression = mean(Expression)), by = .(revcomp_barcode,Element,Experiment,Allele)]
enh_or_rep.empra4 <- ddply(empra.tmp,.(Element,Allele),shufttest,filter(empra.tmp,Allele=="shuf")$Expression,"Expression")
enh_or_rep.empra4$fdr <- p.adjust(enh_or_rep.empra4$Pvalue,"BH")
enh_or_rep.empra4$bonferroni <- p.adjust(enh_or_rep.empra4$Pvalue,"bonferroni")

enh_or_rep.empra4<-as.data.table(enh_or_rep.empra4)
enh_or_rep.empra4<-left_join(enh_or_rep.empra4,allbcs.u,by="Element")
empra_shuf <- enh_or_rep.empra4 %>% .[,plotcolor := as.factor(case_when(
    (coef>log2(1.25) & fdr<0.1) ~ 1,
    (coef<log2(0.75) & fdr<0.1) ~ 2,
    TRUE ~ 3))]

ggplot(empra_shuf)+
  geom_point(aes(x=coef,y=-log10(fdr),fill=plotcolor),shape=21,size=3)+
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("#8e3636","#8e3636","lightgrey"),
                    labels=c("Increased Expostssion","Decreased Expostssion",
                             "Not Significant"))+
  geom_text_repel(data=filter(empra_shuf,plotcolor==1 | plotcolor==2),
                  aes(x=coef,y=-log10(fdr),label=""))+
  labs(fill="Expostssion Change",
       title="Reference vs. Shuffled Expostssion Change\nin post-Splicing Pool",
       x="Log2 Fold Change in Expostssion",
       y="-log10(FDR)")+
  geom_vline(xintercept = log2(0.75),linetype="dashed")+
  geom_vline(xintercept = log2(1.25),linetype="dashed")+
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.1),linetype="dashed")

#####################################################
#Method with making the shuffled across all elements

# First, extract just the rows with "shuf" Allele from presplice.tmp2
shuf_rows <- empra.tmp2[Allele == "shuf"]

# Get the unique Elements from presplice.tmp
target_elements <- unique(empra.tmp$Element)

# Create a new data.table to store all the combined results
combined_results <- copy(empra.tmp)

# For each unique Element in presplice.tmp, take all 132 "shuf" rows 
# from presplice.tmp2 and add them with the Element column updated
for (elem in target_elements) {
  # Make a copy of all the shuf rows
  new_rows <- copy(shuf_rows)
  
  # Replace the Element in each row with the current Element from target_elements
  new_rows[, Element := elem]
  
  # Remove any existing "shuf" rows for this Element in combined_results
  combined_results <- combined_results[!(Element == elem & Allele == "shuf")]
  
  # Add the updated shuffled rows for this Element
  combined_results <- rbindlist(list(combined_results, new_rows), use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
}

# In case we need to ensure only unique rows in the final result
combined_results <- unique(combined_results)

shuf_empra<-mpratools.lm(d=combined_results,
                         model = Expression ~ Allele,
                         ref.level = "shuf",
                         alt.level = "ref")

shuf_empra <- shuf_empra %>%
  .[,plotcolor := as.factor(case_when(
    (logFC>log2(1.25) & fdr<0.1) ~ 1,
    (logFC<log2(0.75) & fdr<0.1) ~ 2,
    TRUE ~ 3))]

shuf_empra<-left_join(shuf_empra,allbcs.u,by="Element")

ggplot(shuf_empra)+
  geom_point(aes(x=logFC,y=-log10(fdr),fill=plotcolor),shape=21,size=3)+
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("#8e3636","#8e3636","lightgrey"),
                    labels=c("Increased Expression","Decreased Expression",
                             "Not Significant"))+
  geom_text_repel(data=filter(shuf_empra,plotcolor==1 | plotcolor==2),
                  aes(x=logFC,y=-log10(fdr),label=""))+
  labs(fill="Expression Change",
       title="Reference vs. Shuffled Expression Change\nin eMPRA Pool",
       x="Log2 Fold Change in Expression",
       y="-log10(FDR)")+
  geom_vline(xintercept = log2(0.75),linetype="dashed")+
  geom_vline(xintercept = log2(1.25),linetype="dashed")+
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.1),linetype="dashed")
```

```{r Comparison Test Allele, include = T}

# Main function to run the pairwise comparisons with the new data tables
run_pairwise_comparisons <- function() {
  # Use the existing data tables instead of creating mock data
  # Assumes 'intron', 'exon', and 'empra' are already loaded in your R environment
  
  # Create the data list with the correct table names
  data_list <- list(
    intron = intron,
    exon = exon,
    empra = empra
  )
  
  # Process the data with custom thresholds
  # Positive: logFC > log2(1.25) & FDR < 0.1
  # Negative: logFC < log2(0.75) & FDR < 0.1
  processed_data <- process_tables(
    data_list, 
    fdr_threshold = 0.1, 
    pos_fold_change = log2(1.25), 
    neg_fold_change = log2(0.75)
  )
  
  # Define output directory
  output_dir <- "venn_diagrams_results/"
  dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  
  # Define the specific comparisons you want with the new table names
  comparisons <- list(
    c("intron", "empra"),
    c("exon", "empra"),
    c("intron", "exon")
  )
  
  # Run each comparison
  for (comp in comparisons) {
    table1 <- comp[1]
    table2 <- comp[2]
    
    # Create main Venn diagram
    create_direction_venn(
      processed_data, 
      table1, 
      table2, 
      output_file = paste0(output_dir, table1, "_vs_", table2, "_venn.pdf")
    )
    
    # Create detailed direction Venn
    create_detailed_direction_venn(
      processed_data, 
      table1, 
      table2, 
      output_file = paste0(output_dir, table1, "_vs_", table2, "_detailed.pdf")
    )
  }
  
  cat("\nVenn diagrams and summary files have been created in the", output_dir, "directory\n")
}

# Execute the analysis
run_pairwise_comparisons()

#    - Element: the element identifier
#    - logFC: the log fold change value
#    - fdr: the FDR value
#
# If column names differ, modify the process_tables() function accordingly
#
# Run the script and check the 'venn_diagrams_results/' directory for the
# generated Venn diagrams and summary files.
```

```{r Stacked Enhancer Bar Plot}
##########################################################
#Stacked Bar Plot for Joe 

combine.isompra<-merge(postsplice_shuf,presplice_shuf,by=c("Element","Allele"))
combine.isompra<-combine.isompra[,c(1,2,3,4,5,6,18,19,20,21,22,34)]
names(combine.isompra)<-c("Element","Allele","logFC.post","pval.post","fdr.post","bonferonni.post","plotcolor.post","logFC.pre","pval.pre","fdr.pre","bonferonni.pre","plotcolor.pre")
combine.isompra$significance <- ifelse((combine.isompra$plotcolor.post == 2 | combine.isompra$plotcolor.post == 1) & combine.isompra$plotcolor.pre == 3, "False-Positive",
                                       ifelse((combine.isompra$plotcolor.pre == 2 | combine.isompra$plotcolor.pre == 1) & combine.isompra$plotcolor.post == 3,"False-Negative",
                                              ifelse((combine.isompra$plotcolor.pre == 2 | combine.isompra$plotcolor.pre == 1 | combine.isompra$plotcolor.post == 2 | combine.isompra$plotcolor.post == 1), "True Positive", "Not Significant")))

combine.isompra$LogFC.pre <- as.numeric(as.character(combine.isompra$logFC.pre))
combine.isompra$LogFC.post <- as.numeric(as.character(combine.isompra$logFC.post))

combine.isompra$LogFC_direction <- case_when(
  is.na(combine.isompra$LogFC.pre) | is.na(combine.isompra$LogFC.post) ~ "Missing data",
  sign(combine.isompra$LogFC.pre) == sign(combine.isompra$LogFC.post) & combine.isompra$LogFC.pre != 0 & combine.isompra$LogFC.post != 0 ~ "Same direction",
  sign(combine.isompra$LogFC.pre) != sign(combine.isompra$LogFC.post) & combine.isompra$LogFC.pre != 0 & combine.isompra$LogFC.post != 0 ~ "Opposite direction",
  combine.isompra$LogFC.pre == 0 | combine.isompra$LogFC.post == 0 ~ "One or both is zero",
  TRUE ~ "Other"
)

combine.isompra <- as.data.table(combine.isompra)
combine.isompra[significance == "True Positive" & LogFC_direction == "Opposite direction", significance := "False-Positive"]

combine.isompra$rand<-"x"

# First, let's reorder the levels of the significance factor
combine.isompra$significance <- factor(combine.isompra$significance, 
                                       levels = c("True Positive", "False-Negative", "False-Positive", "Not Significant"))

# Create the plot with the reordered factor
ggplot(combine.isompra, aes(x = rand, fill = significance)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill", color = "black", size = 0.5) +
  xlab("  ") +
  ylab("  ") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#664e16", "#d4a22b", "#e1be6a","#eedaaa"), 
                    name = "FDR <= 0.2")

summary(combine.isompra$significance)

# Option 1: Scatter plot with LogFC.pre vs LogFC.post with significance coloring
# This visualizes the relationship between LogFC values and shows the different categories

scatter_plot <- ggplot(combine.isompra, aes(x = LogFC.pre, y = LogFC.post)) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = significance), shape = 21, size = 3, color = "black", alpha = 0.7, stroke = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkgray") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkgray") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("True Positive" = "#664e16", 
                               "False-Negative" = "#d4a22b", 
                               "False-Positive" = "#e1be6a", 
                               "Not Significant" = "#eedaaa")) +
  labs(x = "Log Fold Change (Pre-splice)", 
       y = "Log Fold Change (Post-splice)",
       title = "Comparison of LogFC values between Pre-splice and Post-splice") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

# Option 2: Quadrant plot with density
# This shows the distribution of points in each quadrant and adds density estimates

quadrant_plot <- ggplot(combine.isompra, aes(x = LogFC.pre, y = LogFC.post, color = significance)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_density_2d(aes(group = significance), alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkgray") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkgray") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("True Positive" = "green", 
                               "False-Negative" = "red", 
                               "False-Positive" = "blue", 
                               "Not Significant" = "black")) +
  labs(x = "Log Fold Change (Pre-splice)", 
       y = "Log Fold Change (Post-splice)",
       title = "Quadrant Analysis with Density Contours") +
  theme_minimal() +
  facet_wrap(~significance)

# Option 3: Rank-Rank Hexagonal Heatmap (similar to RRHO)
# First, we need to rank the genes by LogFC in both datasets
rank_plot_data <- combine.isompra %>%
  # Remove NA values
  filter(!is.na(LogFC.pre) & !is.na(LogFC.post)) %>%
  # Add ranks
  mutate(
    rank_pre = rank(LogFC.pre),
    rank_post = rank(LogFC.post)
  )

rrho_plot <- ggplot(rank_plot_data, aes(x = rank_pre, y = rank_post)) +
  geom_hex(bins = 50) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(trans = "log10", name = "Count") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(x = "Rank by LogFC (Pre-splice)",
       y = "Rank by LogFC (Post-splice)",
       title = "Rank-Rank Hexagonal Heatmap") +
  theme_minimal()

# Display the plots

scatter_plot
quadrant_plot
rrho_plot
```

```{r Alluvial Plot, include = T}
# Use a direct approach with base R to avoid scoping issues
library(ggalluvial)
library(ggplot2)

# Step 1: First, directly create the status variables
combine.isompra$pre_significant <- combine.isompra$plotcolor.pre == 1 | combine.isompra$plotcolor.pre == 2
combine.isompra$post_significant <- combine.isompra$plotcolor.post == 1 | combine.isompra$plotcolor.post == 2

# Step 2: Create pre_status and post_status directly
combine.isompra$pre_status <- "Other"  # initialize
combine.isompra$pre_status[!combine.isompra$pre_significant] <- "Not Significant"
combine.isompra$pre_status[combine.isompra$pre_significant & combine.isompra$LogFC.pre > 0] <- "Significant Up"
combine.isompra$pre_status[combine.isompra$pre_significant & combine.isompra$LogFC.pre < 0] <- "Significant Down"

combine.isompra$post_status <- "Other"  # initialize
combine.isompra$post_status[!combine.isompra$post_significant] <- "Not Significant"
combine.isompra$post_status[combine.isompra$post_significant & combine.isompra$LogFC.post > 0] <- "Significant Up"
combine.isompra$post_status[combine.isompra$post_significant & combine.isompra$LogFC.post < 0] <- "Significant Down"

# Step 3: Create a frequency table directly with base R
alluvial_counts <- table(combine.isompra$pre_status, combine.isompra$post_status)
print("Table of counts created:")
print(alluvial_counts)

# Step 4: Convert to a data frame
alluvial_data <- as.data.frame(alluvial_counts)
names(alluvial_data) <- c("pre_status", "post_status", "n")

# Step 5: Sort by count
alluvial_data <- alluvial_data[order(alluvial_data$n, decreasing = TRUE), ]
print("Alluvial data prepared:")
print(head(alluvial_data))

# Step 6: Create the alluvial plot
ggplot(alluvial_data, 
       aes(y = n, 
           axis1 = pre_status, 
           axis2 = post_status)) +
  geom_alluvium(aes(fill = pre_status), width = 1/12, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_stratum(width = 1/12, fill = "white", color = "grey") +
  geom_label(stat = "stratum", aes(label = after_stat(stratum))) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "YlOrBr") +
  labs(title = "Flow from Pre-splice to Post-splice Significance",
       y = "Count",
       fill = "Pre-splice Status") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        axis.text.x = element_blank())

# For a three-category plot (including significance), let's create that as well:
# First, define custom significance directly
combine.isompra$custom_significance <- "Other"  # initialize
combine.isompra$custom_significance[
  combine.isompra$pre_status != "Not Significant" & 
  (combine.isompra$post_status == combine.isompra$pre_status)
] <- "True Positive"

combine.isompra$custom_significance[
  combine.isompra$pre_status != "Not Significant" & 
  combine.isompra$post_status == "Not Significant"
] <- "False-Negative"

combine.isompra$custom_significance[
  combine.isompra$pre_status == "Not Significant" & 
  combine.isompra$post_status != "Not Significant"
] <- "False-Positive"

combine.isompra$custom_significance[
  combine.isompra$pre_status == "Not Significant" & 
  combine.isompra$post_status == "Not Significant"
] <- "Not Significant"

# Create a three-way frequency table
alluvial_counts_3way <- table(combine.isompra$pre_status, 
                              combine.isompra$post_status, 
                              combine.isompra$custom_significance)

# Convert to data frame
alluvial_data_3way <- as.data.frame(as.table(alluvial_counts_3way))
names(alluvial_data_3way) <- c("pre_status", "post_status", "custom_significance", "n")

# Remove zero counts
alluvial_data_3way <- alluvial_data_3way[alluvial_data_3way$n > 0, ]

# Sort by count
alluvial_data_3way <- alluvial_data_3way[order(alluvial_data_3way$n, decreasing = TRUE), ]

# Create the three-way alluvial plot
ggplot(alluvial_data_3way, 
       aes(y = n, 
           axis1 = pre_status, 
           axis2 = post_status, 
           axis3 = custom_significance)) +
  geom_alluvium(aes(fill = custom_significance), width = 1/12) +
  geom_stratum(width = 1/12, fill = "white", color = "grey") +
  geom_label(stat = "stratum", aes(label = after_stat(stratum))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("True Positive" = "#d4a22b", 
                              "False-Negative" = "#e1be6a", 
                              "False-Positive" = "#eedaaa", 
                              "Not Significant" = "#fbf6ea",
                              "Other" = "gray80")) +
  labs(title = "Flow from Pre-splice to Post-splice with Significance Categories",
       y = "Count",
       fill = "Significance") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        axis.text.x = element_blank())
```

```{r Other methods VENN DIAGRAM Stuff, include = T}
combine.isompra <- combine.isompra[, c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 18, 19, 20, 21, 22)]
names(combine.isompra) <- c("Element", "logFC.post", "pval.post", "fdr.post", "bonferonni.post", 
                           "plotcolor.post", "logFC.pre", "pval.pre", "fdr.pre", "bonferonni.pre", "plotcolor.pre")

combine.isompra$significance <- ifelse((combine.isompra$plotcolor.post == 2 | combine.isompra$plotcolor.post == 1) & combine.isompra$plotcolor.pre == 3, "False-Positive",
                                       ifelse((combine.isompra$plotcolor.pre == 2 | combine.isompra$plotcolor.pre == 1) & combine.isompra$plotcolor.post == 3,"False-Negative",
                                              ifelse((combine.isompra$plotcolor.pre == 2 | combine.isompra$plotcolor.pre == 1 | combine.isompra$plotcolor.post == 2 | combine.isompra$plotcolor.post == 1), "True Positive", "Not Significant")))

combine.isompra$LogFC.pre <- as.numeric(as.character(combine.isompra$logFC.pre))
combine.isompra$LogFC.post <- as.numeric(as.character(combine.isompra$logFC.post))

combine.isompra$LogFC_direction <- case_when(
  is.na(combine.isompra$LogFC.pre) | is.na(combine.isompra$LogFC.post) ~ "Missing data",
  sign(combine.isompra$LogFC.pre) == sign(combine.isompra$LogFC.post) & combine.isompra$LogFC.pre != 0 & combine.isompra$LogFC.post != 0 ~ "Same direction",
  sign(combine.isompra$LogFC.pre) != sign(combine.isompra$LogFC.post) & combine.isompra$LogFC.pre != 0 & combine.isompra$LogFC.post != 0 ~ "Opposite direction",
  combine.isompra$LogFC.pre == 0 | combine.isompra$LogFC.post == 0 ~ "One or both is zero",
  TRUE ~ "Other"
)

combine.isompra <- as.data.table(combine.isompra)
combine.isompra[significance == "True Positive" & LogFC_direction == "Opposite direction", significance := "False-Positive"]

combine.isompra$rand<-"x"

# First, let's reorder the levels of the significance factor
combine.isompra$significance <- factor(combine.isompra$significance, 
                                       levels = c("True Positive", "False-Negative", "False-Positive", "Not Significant"))

# Create the plot with the reordered factor
ggplot(combine.isompra, aes(x = rand, fill = significance)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill", color = "black", size = 0.5) +
  xlab("  ") +
  ylab("  ") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#664e16", "#d4a22b", "#e1be6a","#eedaaa"), 
                    name = "FDR <= 0.05")

summary(combine.isompra$significance)

# Option 1: Scatter plot with LogFC.pre vs LogFC.post with significance coloring
# This visualizes the relationship between LogFC values and shows the different categories

scatter_plot <- ggplot(combine.isompra, aes(x = LogFC.pre, y = LogFC.post)) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = significance), shape = 21, size = 3, color = "black", alpha = 0.7, stroke = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkgray") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkgray") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("True Positive" = "#664e16", 
                               "False-Negative" = "#d4a22b", 
                               "False-Positive" = "#e1be6a", 
                               "Not Significant" = "#eedaaa")) +
  labs(x = "Log Fold Change (Pre-splice)", 
       y = "Log Fold Change (Post-splice)",
       title = "Comparison of LogFC values between Pre-splice and Post-splice") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

scatter_plot


#Both in the same direction
sum(combine.isompra$plotcolor.post %in% c(1) & combine.isompra$plotcolor.pre %in% c(1))
sum(combine.isompra$plotcolor.post %in% c(2) & combine.isompra$plotcolor.pre %in% c(2))

#Pre Splice Only Sig. Effects
sum(combine.isompra$plotcolor.pre %in% c(1, 2) & combine.isompra$plotcolor.post == 3)

sum(combine.isompra$plotcolor.post %in% c(1, 2) & combine.isompra$plotcolor.pre== 3)
```

```{r Calculating GC content via expression for RT bias question, include = T}

# Read FASTA file
fasta_sequences <- readDNAStringSet("reference.trevino.fasta")

# Calculate GC content (G + C proportion)
gc_content_matrix <- letterFrequency(fasta_sequences, letters = c("G", "C"), as.prob = TRUE)
gc_content <- rowSums(gc_content_matrix) * 100  # Convert to percentage

# Create a data frame with names and GC content
gc_df <- data.frame(
  SequenceName = names(fasta_sequences),
  GC_Content = gc_content
)

# View the result
print(gc_df)

names(gc_df)<-c("Element","GC.Content")

test<-full_join(gc_df,presplice_shuf,by="Element")
test2<-full_join(gc_df,presplice,by="Element")
test2_avg <- test2 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Element) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    GC.Content = dplyr::first(GC.Content),
    avg.Expression = mean(Expression, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(test, aes(x = GC.Content, y = coef)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "blue", linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Log FC vs GC Content",
    x = "GC Content (%)",
    y = "LogFC"
  )

ggplot(test2, aes(x = GC.Content, y = Expression)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "blue", linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Expression vs GC Content",
    x = "GC Content (%)",
    y = "Expression"
  )

ggplot(test2_avg, aes(x = GC.Content, y = avg.Expression)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "blue", linetype = "dashed") +
  stat_cor(
    method = "spearman", 
    aes(label = paste(..r.label.., ..p.label.., sep = "~`,`~")),
    label.x = min(test2_avg$GC.Content, na.rm = TRUE), 
    label.y = max(test2_avg$avg.Expression, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Coefficient vs GC Content",
    x = "GC Content (%)",
    y = "Coefficient"
  )

test5<-full_join(gc_df,postsplice_shuf,by="Element")
test6<-full_join(gc_df,postsplice,by="Element")
test6_avg <- test6 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Element) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(

    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(test5, aes(x = GC.Content, y = coef)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "blue", linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Log FC vs GC Content",
    x = "GC Content (%)",
    y = "LogFC"
  )

ggplot(test6, aes(x = GC.Content, y = Expression)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "blue", linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Expression vs GC Content",
    x = "GC Content (%)",
    y = "Expression"
  )

  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "blue", linetype = "dashed") +
```

```{r Burden Testing for Enhancer and Allelic Effects, include = T}

######################################################################
#Both Enhancers and Repressors Burden Testing

allbcs4<-presplice_shuf
allbcs4 <- allbcs4 %>%
  mutate(ID2 = ifelse(ID == "Non-Priori", "Non-Priori", "Priori"))
allbcs4<-filter(allbcs4,GWAS=="Trevino")

shufallbcs.FDR0.05<-filter(allbcs4, plotcolor %in% c(1, 2))

allbcs4$fdr0.05 <- ifelse(allbcs4$plotcolor %in% c(1, 2), "Sig", "Non-sig")

performChiSquareTest(allbcs4,shufallbcs.FDR0.05,"Case","Control")
performChiSquareTest(allbcs4,shufallbcs.FDR0.05,"Case","Non-Priori")
performChiSquareTest(allbcs4,shufallbcs.FDR0.05,"Control","Non-Priori")
performChiSquareTest2(allbcs4,shufallbcs.FDR0.05,"Priori","Non-Priori")

ggplot(allbcs4, aes(x = ID, fill = fdr0.05)) +
  geom_bar(position="fill")+xlab("  ")+ylab("  ")+scale_fill_manual(values=c("#8d3e01","#d95f02"),name="FDR <= 0.05")
ggplot(allbcs4, aes(x = ID2, fill = fdr0.05)) +
  geom_bar(position="fill")+xlab("  ")+ylab("  ")+scale_fill_manual(values=c("#8d3e01","#d95f02"),name="FDR <= 0.05")

#########################################################
#Just Enhancers Burden Testing

shufallbcs.FDR0.05<-filter(allbcs4, plotcolor %in% c(1, 2))

performChiSquareTest(allbcs4,shufallbcs.FDR0.05,"Case","Non-Priori")
performChiSquareTest(allbcs4,shufallbcs.FDR0.05,"Control","Non-Priori")

  mutate(ID2 = ifelse(ID == "Non-Priori", "Non-Priori", "Priori"))
allbcs4<-filter(allbcs4,coef<=0)
shufallbcs.FDR0.05<-filter(allbcs4, plotcolor %in% c(1, 2))

allbcs4$fdr0.05 <- ifelse(allbcs4$plotcolor %in% c(1, 2), "Sig", "Non-sig")

performChiSquareTest(allbcs4,shufallbcs.FDR0.05,"Case","Control")
performChiSquareTest(allbcs4,shufallbcs.FDR0.05,"Case","Non-Priori")
performChiSquareTest(allbcs4,shufallbcs.FDR0.05,"Control","Non-Priori")
performChiSquareTest2(allbcs4,shufallbcs.FDR0.05,"Priori","Non-Priori")

allbcs3 <- allbcs3 %>%
  mutate(ID2 = ifelse(ID == "Non-Priori", "Non-Priori", "Priori"))

allbcs.FDR0.1 <- filter(allbcs3, plotcolor %in% c(1, 2))
allbcs3$fdr0.1 <- ifelse(allbcs3$plotcolor %in% c(1, 2), "Sig", "Non-sig")

performChiSquareTest(allbcs3,allbcs.FDR0.1,"Case","Control")
performChiSquareTest(allbcs3,allbcs.FDR0.1,"Case","Non-Priori")
performChiSquareTest(allbcs3,allbcs.FDR0.1,"Control","Non-Priori")
performChiSquareTest2(allbcs3,allbcs.FDR0.1,"Priori","Non-Priori")

allbcs3.3<-allbcs3
allbcs3.3<-allbcs3.3[!is.na(allbcs3.3$fdr0.1),]

ggplot(allbcs3.3, aes(x = ID, fill = fdr0.1)) +
  geom_bar(position="fill")+xlab("  ")+ylab("  ")+scale_fill_manual(values=c("#8d3e01","#d95f02"),name="FDR <= 0.1")

ggplot(allbcs3.3, aes(x = ID2, fill = fdr0.1)) +
  geom_bar(position="fill")+xlab("  ")+ylab("  ")+scale_fill_manual(values=c("#8d3e01","#d95f02"),name="FDR <= 0.1")


```

```{r Multi-Plot FDR Change, include = T}

#Presplice
presplice_shuf <- presplice_shuf %>%
  mutate(FDR_group = case_when(
    fdr < 0.05 ~ "FDR < 0.05",
    fdr < 0.1  ~ "0.05 – 0.1",
    fdr < 0.2  ~ "0.1 – 0.2",
    TRUE       ~ "Not Significant"
  ))

ggplot(presplice_shuf) +

  geom_point(
    aes(x = coef, y = -log10(fdr), fill = FDR_group),
    shape = 21,
    size = 3
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "FDR < 0.05" = "#d4a22b",   # orange
      "0.05 – 0.1" = "#e1be6a",   # green
      "0.1 – 0.2"  = "#eedaaa",   # purple
      "Not Significant" = "lightgrey"
    )
  ) +

  geom_text_repel(
    data = filter(presplice_shuf, fdr < 0.2),
    aes(x = coef, y = -log10(fdr), label = ""),
    max.overlaps = Inf
  ) +

  geom_vline(xintercept = log2(0.75), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = log2(1.25), linetype = "dashed") +

  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color="#d4a22b") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.1),  linetype = "dashed", color="#e1be6a") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.2),  linetype = "dashed", color="#eedaaa") +

  labs(
    fill = "FDR Threshold",
    title = "Reference vs. Shuffled Expression Change\nin Pre-Splicing Pool",
    x = "Log2 Fold Change in Expression",
    y = "-log10(FDR)"
  )
```
